essence: The world's deep-sleep bewilderment persists until the final end.
Śrīkaṇṭhanātha is the lord intended as the twenty-sixth here.
By day they stand, and at day's beginning they are manifested.
Here the arrangement of year, day, and related periods is to be done thus.
The repeated thus marks the meaning.
